incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - p99 streaming tail latency spike detected for region-us-west (model=redwood-v1). Alerts sent to oncall rotation.
Priya (oncall): I'm on it. what's the magnitude?
slo-monitor-bot: p95 increased from 120ms -> 340ms; p99 jumped from 420ms -> 1.9s. Streaming connections showing stalls and partial frames. Error rate stable.
Marco (eng-sre): any hardware signals? ECC/thermal?
Jules (infra): thermal alarms on gpu-node-17 and gpu-node-18 in rack-usw-3, fan RPMs spiking. Kernel reports recoverable ECC on node-17.
Nate (runtime): seeing long KV cache stalls and repeated context loads on those nodes. Clients hitting those hosts via smart-router policy.
Priya (oncall): ok, immediate mitigations: 1) cordon gpu-node-17/18, 2) move streaming workloads off, 3) fallback to model-compat-small if needed. Who can evict gracefully?
Jules (infra): I'll start drain now. cordon + drain `gpu-node-17` -> initiating connection drain.
Marco (eng-sre): Nate, please trigger route-evade for region-us-west to avoid those nodes until drained. Add short 2m cool-off to routing.
Nate (runtime): doing `curl -XPOST https://router.internal/evade --data '{"nodes":["gpu-node-17","gpu-node-18"],"ttl":120}'`
Priya (oncall): customer-impact? CS, can you psuh a note?
customer-success: just saw a handful of customers report stalls in console logs, mostly streaming chat UX hangs for ~1-3s. No failed requests reported. We're drafting a brief: "We detected transient latency that may have affected live streaming responsiveness; no data loss."
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15_09:12:22 to runtime-pool-2 completed (no failures)
Marco (eng-sre): checking node logs for ECC churn. snippet: ```
[ kernel ] gpu17: ECC correctable error: 0x2a at address 0x7fffa12b
[ hwmon ] temp_gpu: 92C -> throttle engage
[ runtime ] kv_cache: miss spike, stall duration 900ms
```
Priya (oncall): temp 92C is high — thermal throttle likely causing performance cliff. Are fans stuck? Jules?
Jules (infra): fans oscillating; BMC shows intermittent sensor read errors on node-18. We'll open a hardware ticket and mark nodes for onsite tech. For live, we'll isolate both nodes.
Nate (runtime): after route-evade, p99 dropped to ~650ms and p95 ~220ms. Still above SLO but improving.
Priya (oncall): good. Plan: keep nodes drained, spin up replacement capacity in a different rack, reroute traffic, and enable degraded-mode streaming (lower chunk size) to reduce tail. Marco, can you flip the streaming chunk config?
Marco (eng-sre): can do. changing `stream.chunk_ms` from 50 -> 30 for region-us-west (temporary). Pushing hot config.
Priya (oncall): apply and monitor.
Nate (runtime): config applied. Observability: streaming frame size down, token throughput per conn reduced. p99 now 380ms, p95 180ms.
customer-success: customers on 4 accounts reported UI jitter; we've messaged the affected accounts with an FYI. No escalations yet.
Priya (oncall): good. Who will coordinate hardware swap? Jules. Who owns post-incident? Marco for triage & SLO review, Jules for hardware follow-up, Nate for runtime mitigations.
Jules (infra): I'll schedule tech to replace node-18 tomorrow morning and RMA node-17. Both will stay quarantined.
ops-rotation: Priya, handoff in 30m to Diego. Are we stable enough for handoff?
Priya (oncall): yes — we'll maintain route-evade for 20 more minutes, leave degraded streaming mode for 1 hour, then revert if metrics hold. Diego please ack on takeover.
Diego (ops-rotation): ack, I'll monitor p95/p99 and customer threads.
Marco (eng-sre): quick hypothesis: thermal cycling + repeated ECC correctables cause GPU internal throttling; runtime sees longer KR/KV stalls causing tail amplification. We'll add heatmap of ECC events to triage page.
Priya (oncall): action items logged: * Evacuate gpu-node-17/18 (Jules) * Temporary route-evade + cool-off (Nate) * Degraded streaming chunk size (Marco) * Customer comms (CS) * Postmortem and SLO delta analysis (Marco).
customer-success: posting customers affected list to #customer-updates.
Priya (oncall): one more: increase alert sensitivity for ECC correctables on any node to 3 events/min -> page. We missed earlier threshold. Marco can we tune?
Marco (eng-sre): will update alert rule to 3/min and add a short-term dashboard highlighting ECC bursts by rack.
Nate (runtime): adding auto-fallback: if p99 > 1s for 15s, automatically scale up fallback model pool and switch new sessions to it. Need a quick runbook update.
Priya (oncall): sounds good. Diego, when you take over, please verify: p99 < 500ms for 10m and ECC rate flatlines.
Diego (ops-rotation): will do.
Marco (eng-sre): logging for postmortem: attach router traces, KV stall traces, node hardware logs, and customer session IDs showing stalls.
Jules (infra): hardware ticket created INC-5427, RMA started.
Priya (oncall): closing incident timeline for now. We'll keep thread open for postmortem notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by Priya, severity downgraded to SEV3 after mitigations.
